title: AI browser
description: Lets this AI session open and operate web pages with Chrome on the session's host: read pages, click, fill in forms, take screenshots, read the console. Actions and screenshots show up in the chat.
scope: By default each session has its own browser and a separate profile, deleted when it is turned off (host settings can keep logins instead). Web page content reaches the AI only as data; in read-only plan mode it can only browse and read pages. Stopping a reply pauses it; the next message resumes it.
unavailable: Can't read the status. Check the host connection and the daemon version.
browserMissing: No Chrome, Edge or Chromium found on this host. Install Chrome, or set the browser path in the host settings.
dialogWaiting: The page is waiting on a {{kind}} dialog: {{message}}
waitForTurn: Stop the current reply before turning on the AI browser.
noteHeaded: AI browser switched to a real window
noteHeadless: AI browser is back in the panel
viewPaused: Paused: the AI's browser actions are refused until your next message
viewHeaded: The browser is open in a real window; its picture is mirrored here
viewIdle: Idle. You can use the page here too
viewOffTitle: The AI browser is off for this session
viewOffHint: Once on, the AI drives Chrome on this host and its picture shows here live; you can click and type in it yourself.
viewAddress: Type an address and press Enter to open it in the AI browser
viewHeadedButton: Open in a real window (the browser restarts; unsent form input is lost)
viewHeadlessButton: Back to the panel (the browser restarts; unsent form input is lost)
viewDialog: The page is waiting on a {{kind}} dialog:
viewNotStartedHint: It starts when the AI first uses it. To sign in to a site first, start it now and use the page yourself.
handToAi: Hand to the AI browser: open this page in the session's AI browser
settingsDesc: The Chrome that runs on this host when an AI session turns the browser on. These settings apply to browsers started afterwards; changing the browser path or the allowed domains restarts running browsers.
settingsPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to find Chrome, Edge or Chromium
settingsPersistentHint: All sessions share one browser profile, so cookies and logins survive; only one session can use it at a time. Ignored when allowed domains are set.
settingsDomainsHint: One per line, such as example.com or *.example.com; empty means no limit. Pages, subresources, WebSockets and sendBeacon to other domains are blocked. Page scripts may still get around it, so also deny "Run scripts".
viewStopHint: Stop the AI's reply; browser actions pause until your next message
settingsIgnoreCertHint: HTTPS sites with invalid certificates open anyway (for example self-signed certificates of an internal test server). localhost never checks certificates. The browser restarts after a change.
settingsHiDpiHint: The AI browser renders at 2x, so the live view is sharp on high-DPI screens; page layout is unchanged. It uses more CPU, and pages load their high-resolution images. The AI's screenshots keep their size. Local host only; the browser restarts after a change.
